purpose: Rebuild QTI SDE/SDM source for the Surface port; not a complete HWC or a deployment manifest
limitations: No match to Quest donor C++ ABI is assumed; the five source libraries are a set
Downstream SM8350 UAPI headers describe this userspace build, not proof of kernel6.18 implementation
No secure/HDR/scanout capability inferred from compilation

dpu_plane_properties.scope: alpha, blend and input fence only; no capabilities, output fence or scanout claim

dpu_capabilities.scope: Real QCOM_DPU_CAPS and IN_FORMATS; strict failure if unavailable; eDP built-in classification

sde_mode_request.purpose: Userland half of the driver-owned requested/derived/selected mode state, aligned to the mode-kernel uapi v1 (SDE_MODE_REQUEST_V1 request blob, SDE_MODE_CATALOG_V1 timing-keyed catalog). Legacy QTI request bits are transported as requested state next to the public MODE_ID timing, the kernel wire rules are enforced before submission, one request per atomic transaction is staged, and a stale/partial property set cannot be committed. The kernel catalog/bridge/consumer port is still incomplete and this library set is not deployment-ready.
